entries.name: LocationAccessStore
entries.note: Per-app location grants and the authorization status and error model are in the privacy and location services, with the status model in springboard/ui/src/location_auth.rs. Gap: there is no separate authorization daemon, and the grant prompt is not verified on the lab machine.

entries.name: LocationLogEncryption
entries.note: Encryption of the reference location log store (com.apple.CoreLocation.LocationLogEncryption). BifrOSt writes no location log, so there is no store to encrypt; it stays os pending that decision.

entries.name: LocationSupport

entries.name: LockdownMode
entries.note: Reference hardening profile served by the lockdownmoded XPC daemon (com.apple.LockdownMode). BifrOSt has no equivalent profile; hardening on Arch is handled by the kernel and systemd units, so the choice is not made here and it stays os.

entries.name: LockdownModeUI
entries.note: Settings and prompt UI for the reference hardening profile (com.apple.LockdownModeUI); it depends on the LockdownMode profile, which BifrOSt does not have, so it stays os.

entries.name: LockoutUI
entries.note: Gap: the sign-in attempt counter and temporary lock exist in springboard/core/src/password_verify.rs (Attempts), but there is no lock screen panel that shows the lockout and the wait time. Build that panel in the shell lock screen.

entries.name: LoggingSupport
entries.note: Unified logging for apps (os.Logger and the log store) is implemented in bifrost_core::log, with per-argument privacy formatting in springboard/core/src/log_format.rs. Gap: system-wide journal integration with systemd is not verified on the lab machine.

entries.name: LoginUIKit
entries.note: Reference bundle com.apple.LoginUIKit with only an Info.plist in the reference extract (no binary, strings or headers were readable), so the purpose is not determined and it stays os.

entries.name: Lookup
entries.note: Gap: no system-wide Look Up service shows a definition for selected text. The dictionary app (springboard/apps/dictionary-desktop/src/main.rs) looks words up only inside itself. Build a Look Up service and popover that other apps can call.

entries.name: LowPowerMode
entries.note: The shell hands its power profile to power-profiles-daemon through powerprofilesctl. Gap: there is no Low Power Mode toggle or app-facing power-state API, and the profile change is not verified on the lab machine.

entries.name: kperf
entries.note: Kernel performance counter bridge used by the reference profiler (kperf.framework, com.apple.kperf). Arch offers the perf tool (listed as a candidate in tools/parity/os_cli_packages.txt, not shipped), so it stays os.
